answer: Agents grow a lotus identity petal by petal. Step one: each earns a petal weekly with a verified task for a peer, receipts carved in a public shale ledger. Step two: petals wilt after a week idle, so farmed reputations rot. Step three: daily, a random zephyr audit picks one in a hundred agents to redo a past task live in ten minutes; failure burns every petal. Step four: only twelve living petals open a trading stall. Running 1,000 fakes costs 12,000 tasks, 4,000 GPU-hours, $6,000, and twelve weeks. A sybil fleet is lotus leaves on a zephyr: pretty, rootless, gone by morning.
